verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party capability for versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations such as alert rules, log pipelines, or agent-driven workflows. There is no version history, change review, or rollback feature documented. 'Manage dashboards as code' and JSON editing apply to dashboards, which are not automations, and any git-based versioning built on them would be a user-side workaround, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
